note: [L] makes the choices in constructionRun/fundedRun, before any extraction order, and uses them in continuum_with_position_tests and YangMills.constructed. The difference: the Wilson initialization, the RG advance and the trajectory selection are bundled into one selection theorem rather than stated as separate stages.

snippet.text:
theorem constructionRun {G : Gauge} (hG : G.Simple) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ (R : Run G) (T : Campaign R) (W : Campaign.Pillars R T),
      R.family.path.levels.clock.kernel.penalty = b ∧
      R2I.Funded (garment10 G) R T ∧ ActualRunNativeComponentRecipe.Attached R := by
  have hTrue : R2I.EventuallyPaid (fun _ : RG.Levels G => True) :=
    fun _ _ _ V => ⟨V, Push.PriceCompiler.DelayLe.refl _, by intros; trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨R,T,hb',hSelected,_,_,_,_,⟨W⟩,hf,_⟩ :=
    R2I.RG05Joint.selectRunWithTreasuryPeriod_preselected_quote_orders_postnumeric
      (RiderResourceDynamics.defaultDynamics G).cultivate (CustodyR.minted G)
      (garment10 G) b hb hG hTrue
      (fun s (_ : Precision.MapPrices) => NativeComponentRecipe.Choice s)
      (fun s _ => NativeComponentRecipe.available hG s)
      NativeComponentRecipe.floor NativeComponentRecipe.numeric
      ActualRunNativeComponentRecipe.postnumeric
  exact ⟨R,T,W,hb',hf,ActualRunNativeComponentRecipe.of_preselection R hSelected⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For simple G and b > 0, a funded Wilson run with penalty b is selected (via selectRunWithTreasuryPeriod_preselected_quote_orders_postnumeric) before any extraction order.

snippet.text:
theorem continuum_with_position_tests {G : Gauge} (hG : G.Simple) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    let R := fundedRun hG hb
    R.family.path.levels.clock.kernel.penalty = b ∧
    ∀ p : Extraction.Order, ∃ (q : Extraction.Order) (S : Table R.family.book)
      (F : Final R.family (p.refine q) S) (L : EveryPhase.Almanac F)
      (Q : Reader F.sector.derivatives F.sector.turns F.room.kernel.spin)
      (M : Contacts.Devices F.sector.derivatives),
      (Extraction.Order.mk Extraction.Sequence.full (p.refine q).per).Ordered R.family S ∧
      FullVolume.PositionsUV R.family Extraction.Sequence.full ∧ Core.{u,v} hG F L Q ∧
      OPE.Nesting.Uniform F Q ∧ M.basis = Q.port ∧ MultipleLight F M ∧
      Nonempty (Contacts.Transport.SystemBasis M) ∧ Nonempty (Thresholds M) ∧
      ∃ X : Climb.Scaling S, Pert.FirstExtension F X ∧ Pert.Position.FourMeters F X := by
  obtain ⟨T,W,penalty,funded,_⟩ := (constructionRun hG hb).choose_spec
  refine ⟨penalty,?_⟩
  intro p
  obtain ⟨q,_,S,F,X,L,Q,_,ordered,uv,first,reconstruction,trace,service,ope,nested,_,_⟩ :=
    (R2IGoals.fromFunded.{u} W hG funded).refine p
  obtain ⟨M,same,contacts,basis,thresholds⟩ := contacts_on F Q service.toServices
  exact ⟨q,S,F,L,Q,M,ordered,uv,
    Core.of_receipts hG F L Q reconstruction trace service.toServices ope,
    nested,same,contacts,basis,thresholds,X,first,Pert.Position.four_on F X hG first⟩

proof_context.conclusion: With the run fundedRun fixed, each requested extraction order p is refined afterwards.
